name: JJ Food
area: Old Tehri Road, New Tehri Town
why_it_matters: Top-ranked independent restaurant in New Tehri (TripAdvisor #2 of 13; ~370+ reviews on Justdial). Run by Vijay Tiwari and his father; rooftop has panoramic Tehri Lake and Dobra-Chanthi bridge views. Cheap, consistent Indo-Chinese — the working town's go-to.
insider_tip: Take a rooftop table for the lake-and-bridge view; service can lag at peak lunch so order the mushroom masala upfront with the chowmein.
signature_address: Plot No. 1, Near Police Station, Near ITI, Old Tehri Road, New Tehri 249001

name: Lake View Restaurant & Hotel
why_it_matters: Owner-run by Jagdeep Panwar at Lambgaon on the Tehri Dam Road, 65 km from Rishikesh. One of the few Koti-area kitchens that actually serves Tehri-reservoir fish — most lakeside places are pure-veg. Lake-facing dining and a charcoal grill.
insider_tip: Call ahead (+91 78955 51906) — fish needs notice and walk-ins on weekends often miss out. The pahadi thali is the safer bet on weekdays.
signature_address: Tehri Dam Road, Lambgaon, Panch Koti, Tehri Garhwal 249001

name: Hotel Le ROI Lake View — Multicuisine Restaurant
why_it_matters: Le ROI's lakeside property at Koti — wooden interiors, lake-facing dining hall, the most reliable buffet in the Koti Colony cluster. Open to walk-in diners as well as in-house guests, which is unusual for the area's resort restaurants.
insider_tip: Book the buffet at lunch rather than dinner — the lake view from the dining room is the whole point and it's wasted after sundown.

name: Le ROI Floating Huts — Lobby Multicuisine Restaurant
signature_dish: buffet thali (no onion-no garlic on request)
why_it_matters: Lobby-level multicuisine restaurant inside India's first floating-huts property on Tehri Lake. Strictly pure-veg (no alcohol on premises), buffet-style, with live music most evenings — and the only Tehri dining room that's literally over the water.
insider_tip: Non-resident diners must book ahead — call the resort to confirm a slot. The kitchen will do no-onion-no-garlic plates if asked at booking, useful during shravan/navratri.
signature_address: Le ROI Floating Huts & Eco Rooms, Plas village, Tehri Lake, Tehri Garhwal

name: GMVN Tehri Lake Eco Huts — Lakeside Restaurant
why_it_matters: Garhwal Mandal Vikas Nigam (Uttarakhand state tourism) operates this lakeside canteen alongside their eco-huts at Koti Colony. The most affordable sit-down on the lake — homely, vegetarian, no frills, but the views match anything else here.
insider_tip: Order on arrival, not at meal-time — the kitchen runs on a small staff and food arrives 30-40 min after order. Breakfast is the best meal; dinner menu is thin.
signature_address: GMVN Tehri Lake Eco Huts, Koti Colony, Tehri Garhwal 249001

name: Food Station (DLS Tehri Club Resort)
why_it_matters: DLS Hotels' resort dining room overlooking the Tehri ranges, halfway between Chamba and Tehri Lake. One of the few mid-range kitchens in the area that puts genuine Garhwali signatures on the menu — Bhaddu Ki Daal (slow-cooked overnight in a copper bhaddu pot) being the marquee dish.
insider_tip: Order Bhaddu Ki Daal at lunch — it's slow-simmered through the morning and at its best by 1pm. Walk-ins accepted but book the same morning to confirm a table.
signature_address: Tehri Club Resort By DLS Hotels, Watkhem, Chamba 249145

name: Shubham Family Restaurant
why_it_matters: Burari Market sit-down with the cleanest reputation in New Tehri's open-market strip — 4.3 on Justdial across ~300 reviews, listed on Zomato (rare for the town), pure-veg, working-family priced. The menu sweep covers Indo-Chinese, dosa, and full thalis.
insider_tip: It's on the upper market level — windows on the lake-facing side give you a rooftop view of New Tehri's terraces, ask for that section.
signature_address: F&G Unit 1 St, Burari Market, Open Market, New Tehri 249001
